response.text:
I can’t read or summarize Q4-results-final.pdf until I can inspect the actual file. I won’t guess from the filename. To produce a reliable, verifiable summary please provide one of the following and answer a few quick questions about scope and format:

What to provide (one of these)
- Upload the PDF file here (best).
- Paste the PDF text or key excerpts (copy/paste).
- Provide page images/screenshots for pages you want summarized.
- Provide an accessible URL to the PDF (confirm it’s publicly reachable).

Essential clarifications (choose / answer)
- Scope: full-document summary or specific sections (e.g., financial results, management discussion, outlook, risks, footnotes, appendix)?
- Level of detail: short executive summary (3–5 bullets), one-page summary, or detailed section-by-section summary?
- Audience: CEO/board, investors, analysts, internal team—this affects tone and emphasis.
- Numeric detail: do you want exact figures called out (revenue, EPS, guidance) with page citations, or just trends and highlights?
- Charts/tables: should I extract table/chart values into a table or CSV, or only describe trends/insights? (Note: extracting exact numbers requires inspecting the source pages.)
- Comparisons: do you want comparisons to prior quarters/YE or market expectations? If yes, provide the prior documents or say whether I should compare to the company’s prior-quarter figures you’ll provide.
- Confidentiality: is the document private or sensitive? Any redaction requirements?

Optional helpful items
- A one-sentence summary of what you most want from the summary (e.g., “I need five investor-ready bullets and the top 3 risks”).
- Any glossary or abbreviations used in the PDF (if unusual).
- Associated spreadsheets or slide deck (if you want data extraction or slides prepared).

Format choices for delivery
- Bulleted executive summary + 2–3 supporting details per bullet
- Section-by-section summary with page citations
- Key metrics table (with page citations) + short commentary
- Suggested talking points and Q&A for investors

Next steps
- Upload the PDF or paste content and tell me which scope/format you prefer. If you want, I can also give a summary template you can fill in and I’ll polish it. Which option do you prefer?
